routes.dispositionReason: The 'Ask in plain language' card was WITHDRAWN from /search for every workspace type after an audit of what it displayed, so this route is deliberately unmounted rather than accidentally orphaned. Two defects, both in runStateQuery: (1) two of its seven presets synthesise titles instead of reading the record's name — REVIEW_BACKLOG renders 'Review <id8>… (STATUS)' and REPORTS_RECENT renders 'Report v<n>' while routing to /evidence/:id; (2) the state presets query prisma.evidence / evidenceReviewWorkflow / report directly on teamId alone, bypassing the reviewer-restriction gate executeSearch applies twice, so a non-reviewer saw rows ordinary Search withholds. Cross-workspace leakage was NOT possible — authorizeOrFail verifies ACTIVE membership in body.teamId and every state query carries it. The route is retained (registered, authorized, rate-limited, audited) because this repository does not delete routes; the TEXT_SEARCH branch is unaffected as it delegates to executeSearch. Reintroduction requires: state presets through the authorized search path, canonical display names, a real total rather than the page length, and demonstrated value over ordinary Search.
